device.model: HD8155 (System ID 6B000A00, Edision GUI v.1440 build)
device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD H.265/HEVC satellite receiver with CA card reader, Ethernet and USB Wi-Fi
device.soc: ALi M3521A / C3505 with 128 MB DDR3 (maincode "ALI_C3505:0x%x", seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xA6000200)

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko / Edision firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko / Edision
source.note: Archive AMIKO 8155 Edision_v.1440.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB DDR3 C3505 board (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_hd8155_v1440_app_starts.py, run_dump_hd8155_v1440_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs in boot SRAM at 0x9FE00800, unpacks maincode(AV) (chips/base.py:maincode) to 0x80000200 and seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA6000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x86002001).  The application drives the CH455 front panel on GPIO 107 / 110 (" ON ", " on "), initialises its 60-entry remote key table (0x60xx, "necfirst" coding) and MCAS database, and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD through the display engine at 0xB8006900 (5 GE commands, 14 unique colours; without the board's anti-clone security IC it displays the hardware-ID warning dialog "SW is not designed for this HW, please change back to offical SW!-----00000000000000 6b000a00").

desc: Amiko HD8155 (System ID 6B000A00) firmware v.1440 with the Edision GUI (2020-03-10) for the Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the ALi M3521A / C3505 SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Uses a "maincode(AV)" application chunk name (chips/base.py), a CH455 (TM1650-compatible) 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 107 / 110, and the Amiko / Edision 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
